title: Self-Refining Vision Language Model for Robotic Failure Detection and Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2602.12405v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reasoning about failures is crucial for building reliable and trustworthy robotic systems. Prior approaches either treat failure reasoning as a closed-set classification problem or assume access to ample human annotations. Failures in the real world are typically subtle, combinatorial, and difficult to enumerate, whereas rich reasoning labels are expensive to acquire. We address this problem by introducing ARMOR: Adaptive Round-based Multi-task mOdel for Robotic failure detection and reasoning. We formulate detection and reasoning as a multi-task self-refinement process, where the model iteratively predicts detection outcomes and natural language reasoning conditioned on past outputs. During training, ARMOR learns from heterogeneous supervision - large-scale sparse binary labels and small-scale rich reasoning annotations - optimized via a combination of offline and online imitation learning. translated_title: 用于机器人故障检测与推理的自精炼视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 对故障进行推理对于构建可靠且值得信赖的机器人系统至关重要。先前的方法要么将故障推理视为闭集分类问题，要么假设可以获得充足的人工标注。然而现实世界中的故障通常是微妙的、组合性的，且难以穷举，而丰富的推理标注获取成本高昂。我们通过提出ARMOR（Adaptive Round-based Multi-task mOdel，面向机器人故障检测与推理的自适应多轮多任务模型）来解决这一问题。我们将故障检测和推理形式化为一个多任务自精炼过程，模型基于过去的输出迭代地预测检测结果和自然语言推理。在训练过程中，ARMOR从异构监督中学习——包括大规模的稀疏二值标签和小规模的丰富推理标注——并通过离线与在线模仿学习相结合的方式进行优化。在推理时，ARMOR生成多……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ARMOR提出了一种多任务自精炼框架，通过融合大规模稀疏二值标签与小规模丰富推理标注的异构监督，并结合离线与在线模仿学习，实现对机器人故障的迭代式检测与自然语言推理，摆脱了对大量人工标注的依赖。
en_tdlr: ARMOR introduces a multi-task self-refinement framework that iteratively detects robotic failures and generates natural-language reasoning, leveraging heterogeneous supervision—large-scale sparse binary labels plus small-scale rich reasoning annotations—optimized through offline and online imitation learning.
